title: Rodelet–Causse–Tevlin log-convexity conjecture for super Narayana polynomials
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, let $p_k=N_{m+k}^{(m)}(1,t)$ for $k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$. Then the sequence $(p_k)_{k\ge 0}$ is $t$-log-convex; that is, for every $k\ge 1$, the polynomial $p_{k+1}(t)p_{k-1}(t)-p_k(t)^2$ has nonnegative coefficients.
references: - [Continuous Narayana Interpolations: Hankel Total Positivity and Log-Convexity Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19548) — arXiv — Jiang Zeng

progress.label: Open · solution reported
progress.tldr: A 2026 preprint claims to settle the conjecture and prove stronger positivity results, but its exact connection to the original statement has not been independently checked.
progress.summary:
Rodelet–Causse and Tevlin formulated the conjecture in a paper submitted on May 14, 2025: for every $m \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, the sequence $N_n^{(m)}(1,t)$ beginning at $n=m$ is $t$-log-convex, meaning that successive differences $p_{k+1}(t)p_{k-1}(t)-p_k(t)^2$ have nonnegative coefficients.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09821)*

**Known results**

- The cases $m=0$ and $m=1$ were already known before the general conjecture (Rodelet–Causse and Tevlin, 2025).

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09821)*

**October 14, 2026 preprint**

Jiang Zeng’s *Continuous Narayana Interpolations: Hankel Total Positivity and Log-Convexity Preservation* claims results implying the conjectured log-convexity and extending it to broader Hankel total positivity, real-rootedness, moment, and preservation statements. The abstract does not explicitly match the original conjecture parameter by parameter, so the claimed resolution remains unverified.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19548) · [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.19548v1)*

Current status (as of October 2026): The cases $m=0$ and $m=1$ are established, while a 2026 preprint claims the full conjecture and stronger results; that claim remains unverified.

*Caveats. The available evidence is an unrefereed preprint whose abstract does not explicitly state the original conjecture in its parameter-by-parameter form.*
